name: knx-mcp-claude
description: Connect named KNX ETS endpoints using private profiles or two optional test connections.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop on Windows to KNX-MCP ETS app 1.2.0.4 or a compatible later version. Prefer exported profiles for named ETS5/ETS6 endpoints. Two optional manual connections accept a name, URL and bearer token. HTTPS validates certificates; HTTP requires explicit consent. Uses the host Node.js runtime. ETS permissions and confirmations remain active. Tool results are shared with the AI host.

connection_files.title: Connection profiles (recommended)
connection_files.description: Select up to 32 KNX-MCP-*.json files exported from the addon. Each contains an access key and a public certificate. Keep the files private. Optional when a complete manual connection is provided.

manual_1_name.title: Test connection 1 — Name
manual_1_name.description: Optional test connection. Complete Name, URL and token together or leave all three empty. This name identifies the target in tool titles.

manual_1_url.title: Test connection 1 — Remote / Local URL
manual_1_url.description: Explicit http:// or https:// URL with server name/IP and port. /mcp is added if no path is entered. For HTTPS, trust the verified certificate in the supported Windows Trusted store, or use an exported profile instead.

manual_1_token.title: Test connection 1 — Bearer token
manual_1_token.description: Enter only the access key, without “Bearer”. Stored as a sensitive host setting. Never include the token in the URL.

manual_2_name.title: Test connection 2 — Name
manual_2_name.description: Optional test connection. Complete Name, URL and token together or leave all three empty. This name identifies the target in tool titles.

manual_2_url.title: Test connection 2 — Remote / Local URL
manual_2_url.description: Explicit http:// or https:// URL with server name/IP and port. /mcp is added if no path is entered. For HTTPS, trust the verified certificate in the supported Windows Trusted store, or use an exported profile instead.

manual_2_token.title: Test connection 2 — Bearer token
manual_2_token.description: Enter only the access key, without “Bearer”. Stored as a sensitive host setting. Never include the token in the URL.

allow_insecure_http.title: Allow unencrypted HTTP test connections
allow_insecure_http.description: Off by default. HTTP exposes access keys and project data in transit. Use only for an intentional local or protected test. HTTPS never falls back to HTTP.
